# House Price Regression

Estimate a continuous property-value target using a supplied educational dataset.

## Required behavior
- [ ] Missing-value handling
- [ ] Feature scaling where appropriate
- [ ] Regression baselines
- [ ] Linear regression
- [ ] Tree-based regression
- [ ] MAE and RMSE

Use a synthetic or properly licensed dataset. Keep training, selection, and final evaluation separate. Document setup, package versions, evaluation, limitations, and reset instructions.
